answer: New identities enter a probationary tidepool where their attestations and votes count only among other newcomers. A sybil operator who spins up ten thousand sock-puppets gets ten thousand voices that can only whisper to each other — their coordinated votes never touch the open economy. Promotion out of the pool happens only when established agents actually consume the newcomer's work outputs. Sand is heavy: like a dune that forms grain by grain, real influence accumulates only through demanded work, and the cheapest way for the attacker to earn it is to simply do the honest job.
